# SceneSmith

> SceneSmith is social media publishing and scheduling software for Instagram, X, and LinkedIn. Create posts in ChatGPT or another MCP-compatible client, or in the SceneSmith web composer. Review the exact draft, account, and time before approving a post to publish now or later.

The public product site is https://scenesmith.design. The application is https://app.scenesmith.design. The application host is not the canonical marketing site.

## Product

- Create and edit platform-specific social posts from ChatGPT, compatible MCP clients, or the SceneSmith web composer.
- Connect Instagram, X, and LinkedIn accounts to a workspace.
- Preview the post and destination, then approve publishing or scheduling.
- Use a calendar to review drafts, scheduled posts, published posts, and delivery status.
- Keep brands and their connected accounts organized in separate workspaces.
- Product and plan details: https://scenesmith.design/#pricing
